info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Logs API

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results per page. Value must be between 1 and 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. Value must be greater to 1.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Defined whether or not to filter out logs created after this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: created_before
params.description: Defined whether or not to filter out logs created before this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: action
params.description: Defined whether or not to filter out by a specific action.

params.name: resource_type
params.description: Defined whether or not to filter out by a specific type of resource.

params.name: search
params.description: Defined whether or not to filter out log by bearer ID or resource ID.

items.docs: List logs available for given Organization. You must define the `organization_id` in the query path of your request.

Retrieve information about a log, specified by the `log_id` parameter. The log's full details, including `id`, `ip`, `user_agent`, `action`, `bearer_id`, `resource_type` and `resource_id` are returned in the response.
